thread:
Maya Patel: :rotating_light: incident-bot flagged sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate, paging oncall
incident-bot: [AUTOMATED] AlertID=INC-3421 severity=critical metric=5xx_rate route=/v1/generate value=78/min threshold=50/min
TJ: I'm on it. starting with logs and recent deploys. any rollout in last 30m? @simon
Simon K: yup, pushed canary of quantized-ggml@v3 18m ago, but CPU metrics looked fine. pulling logs now.
Eli: getting 500s with OOM-ish stack traces in worker-12. might be cache eviction thrash.
TJ: ok pausing canary via rollout controller. if error rate drops we correlate.
Maya Patel: Customer impact: a handful of customers saw timeouts, support inbox reports + one SLO breach in last 10m. tagging support.
Neha: putting initial mitigation: set autoscaler min_replicas=4 for that pool, bump KV cache size. doing now.
TJ: applying alert noise mute: silencing raw 5xx alerts for route=/v1/generate while we stabilize. will replace with aggregated alert in 5m.
Simon K: rollback canary completed. watching.
incident-bot: Deploy rollback executed by Simon K at 06:15 UTC
Eli: error rate falling to baseline. looks like correlated regressor from canary. good.
TJ: starting handoff notes for next oncall (Sasha). summary: cause=regression in canary quantized-ggml@v3; impact=timeouts/5xx on /v1/generate; mitigations=rollback, scale up, KV cache bump; customer impact partial, ticket INC-3421 created.
Neha: @Sasha assigning follow-up: create an alert grouping rule, add dashboard graphs for per-model+route 5xx and tail latency, and create a postmortem doc.
Maya Patel: Proposed alert change (temp):
```
alert: AggregatedHigh5xxGenerate
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status=~"5.."}[2m])) by (route,model) > 30
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/agg-5xx
```
And tuning:
- group_by: [route, model]
- dedupe_key: '{{ $labels.route }}:{{ $labels.model }}'
- rate_limit: '1m'
- suppress_for: 10m after deploy events
```
TJ: We'll deploy grouping rule to Alertmanager and add a synthetic probe hitting /v1/generate every 1m to catch regression earlier.
Simon K: creating dashboard MON-112 with per-model 95/99 latency and 5xx histograms. link: https://grafana.redwood/r/mon112
Neha: owners: infra-ml (alerting), eng-sre (dashboards), product-slo (customer comms).
Maya Patel: Post-incident TODOs:
• update runbook with dedupe key example
• add deploy-hook to suppress noisy transient alerts for 15m
• add unit tests for canary to include synthetic end-to-end path
• follow-up postmortem doc INC-3421
TJ: handoff to @Sasha in 25m with these notes. leaving page open till then. :thumbsup:
Sasha: acknowledged, will take over and start the follow-ups. please DM if anything else.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone, marking incident 'resolved' in PD. I'll open a postmortem draft and ping for reviews. :white_check_mark:
